scope.acceptance: Exact-artifact acceptance exclusively for GE_BEAM3_NATIVE_OWNED_WORKFLOWS_V1 and its previously reviewed section, geometry, state, and workflow domain.
limitations: Previously reviewed mathematical and engineering campaigns were not rerun or mechanically recomputed during this artifact adjudication.

No qualification of arbitrary materials, arbitrary geometry, generic mixed FEModel integration, plastic/fibre-shell coupling, finite-velocity dynamics, or inadmissible active-yield/nonconservative spectral states.

Acceptance does not change defaults, authorize publication or tagging, or establish universal physical qualification. Subsequent archival copies and documentation commits are outside this exact-artifact verdict.
